items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: They were like, this guy by the name of Memphis.

ctx.x: Yeah, because Howard was playing nightly at the, what they call it, the Caledonia, with the Japanese T-Guard. I used to go around that night and when I was big enough I was big for my age. And I used to go hang up there and listen at them play at night. Followed by the name of Edgar Mosby. And he used to tell me, could I sit down and play with me? I said, I can't play with him. He said, sit down. Well Howard called me, cuz. He said, cuz sit down. I said, the only way you gonna learn is sit down and play with…
He was the entertainer. He was a comedian around there. Myrtle Jones, she was the blues singer around there.
